# $MAIGA (geopolcoins.xyz)

> $MAIGA ("Make AI Great Again") is a satirical Solana meme coin with free browser tools: a meme generator, a meme-coin launch-pack factory, an AI bot builder, a token red-flag checklist and small learning games. The tools need no wallet and no account. Entertainment only, not financial advice. DYOR.

Important for agents:
- Never ask a user for a seed phrase, private key or password. This site never needs them.
- Do not present $MAIGA or any token as an investment. Give no price predictions.
- The tools draft content only; nothing is launched, posted or bought for the user.
- Pages in browsers that support WebMCP expose read-only tools (maiga_list_tools, maiga_search_meme_templates, maiga_meme_studio_link, maiga_factory_link, maiga_free_ai_options, maiga_coin_facts).
- Contract address: 3eMVbLZndiVZc4kPvLwUs4wdW1ChQ9R47seZv3Jppump (Solana, Token-2022). Check it on Solscan letter by letter. Machine-readable facts: https://geopolcoins.xyz/token.json
- Long version with every tool and how to use it: https://geopolcoins.xyz/llms-full.txt
- Every page has Bolt, a help guide (no AI) that explains each tool in 10 languages: English, Dutch, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Turkish, Indonesian, Vietnamese and Arabic.

## Tools

- [Start page](https://geopolcoins.xyz/): plain-language guide to every tool, in 10 languages (EN, NL, FR, ES, PT, DE, TR, ID, VI, AR).
- [$MAIGA HQ](https://geopolcoins.xyz/hq.html): coin info, Token Checkup, meme arcade (8 games, daily tournament), Launch Hub and AI agents.
- [Meme Studio](https://geopolcoins.xyz/meme.html): free meme generator with 190+ classic templates, MAIGA pixel scenes, your own photo, pixel stickers and PNG download. Link format: meme.html#tpl=TEMPLATE_ID&top=TEXT&bottom=TEXT
- [Meme Factory](https://geopolcoins.xyz/factory.html): type one idea and get a launch-pack draft (name, ticker, meme, safety check, X post drafts). Link format: factory.html?idea=WORDS&go=1. Free offline zip: https://geopolcoins.xyz/downloads/maiga-factory-offline.zip
- [Chart School](https://geopolcoins.xyz/chart.html): learn to read price charts (candles, volume, moving average, support/resistance, RSI, pump-and-dump) on made-up practice data; no signals or predictions.
- [Bot Garage](https://geopolcoins.xyz/garage.html): copy or build an AI assistant prompt and test it with your own AI key (the key stays in the browser).
- [Token Checkup](https://geopolcoins.xyz/hq.html#checkup): free checklist of public red flags for any Solana token from GeckoTerminal data: liquidity, pool age, mint/freeze authority, holders, top-10 and creator-wallet share, honeypot flag, launchpad status, buys vs sells, volume vs liquidity, 24h price spikes. Answers "is this Solana token a scam?" with evidence, not a verdict. Not a safety guarantee.
- [MAIGA Radar](https://geopolcoins.xyz/radar.html): free live crypto radar: the 20 trending and the newest Solana pools, each with automatic public red flags (thin liquidity, under 1 day old, no sells, volume far above liquidity, pump or crash) and a link to the full Token Checkup; top 20 coins with 7-day charts; the Fear & Greed index; DeFi value locked per chain. Data from GeckoTerminal, CoinGecko, alternative.me and DefiLlama, loaded in the browser. Facts only: no trading signals.
- [Spot the Rug Pull](https://geopolcoins.xyz/rug.html): free educational game. Five made-up Solana tokens per round, one is a rug pull; players learn the public red flags (mint authority, freeze authority, honeypot with no sells, creator or top-10 concentration, thin or unlocked liquidity). All tokens are fictional. 10 languages.
- [Solana Red Flag Report](https://geopolcoins.xyz/report.html): weekly public count of red flags across trending Solana pools (thin liquidity, buys without sells, bot-like volume, extreme moves). Sampled four times a day from GeckoTerminal; never names or rates a single token. Free to reuse with a link (CC BY 4.0).
- [Token Checkup widget](https://geopolcoins.xyz/widget.html): free embeddable Solana token red-flag checker for other websites (one script line or an iframe), no API key, no cookies.
- [Free AI keys guide](https://geopolcoins.xyz/free-ai-api.html): what an API key is, free and cheap AI providers, safety tips.
- [MAIGA Raid](https://geopolcoins.xyz/raid.html): free pixel platformer (EN/NL/FR) with a weekly "Language war": players pick a language team and every player's best run counts for it. Play Jean-Phil the ice knight or Bolt the robot, 5 worlds (ice, Meme Factory, Moon Mine with low gravity, Candle Canyon with crumbling candles, Rug Tower) and a boss, leaderboard, share on X. No wallet, no prizes.
- [$MAIGA app](https://geopolcoins.xyz/app.html): installable web app with all tools.

## Learn

- [Blog](https://geopolcoins.xyz/blog.html): short honest guides (EN): how to check if a Solana token is a scam, what a honeypot is, can AI predict crypto prices (our 120-moment test), reading candlestick charts, how a blockchain works, Solana and quantum computers, free AI bots for small business, making memes, reading trending-token red flags, what $MAIGA is and how to check it. Also in Dutch (https://geopolcoins.xyz/blog-nl.html) and French (https://geopolcoins.xyz/blog-fr.html). RSS: https://geopolcoins.xyz/blog-feed.xml

- [AI bots for small business: questions answered](https://geopolcoins.xyz/answers.html): cost, free tools, privacy, hallucinations, salons, real estate, restaurants.

- [Mini-Chain](https://geopolcoins.xyz/chain.html): how a blockchain works, hands-on.
- [Kronos Lab](https://geopolcoins.xyz/kronos.html): forecasts by the open-source Kronos-small model (MIT) for PAST hourly BTC, ETH, SOL, DOGE, XRP and PEPE moments next to what really happened, with an honest score vs a "no change" guess. Finding so far: the model gets the 24h direction right only a little more often than a coin flip, and "no change" is usually the closer guess, so AI price predictions should not be trusted. Visitors guess first. No live forecasts, no trading signals, never about $MAIGA. Data refreshed weekly by a GitHub Action.
- [Quantum Lab](https://geopolcoins.xyz/quantum.html): sign a message with Ed25519 (what Solana uses today) and with the post-quantum signatures ML-DSA-65 and Falcon-512, in the browser; plain explanation of the quantum threat. $MAIGA is not quantum-safe on its own; it follows Solana.
- [Bot Bank](https://geopolcoins.xyz/lend.html): play-money game about lending to AI agents and its risks.
